descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S08 Note generation fails in both contexts: 'Note not generated', dictation kept, no fabricated note, and a failed regenerate keeps the physician's edits

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4a Note generation failed: "Note not generated" is shown and the dictation is kept. (UAT EFS state 4; TFA-94745 state 4)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture plus a second chart per context ({hospitalPatient2}, {snfResident2}) seeded with a note generated earlier today whose text holds the physician's edit 'QA-EFS-EDIT added by the physician.'; every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails at the client

When (a) Type the encounter text, press Generate Note & Finish and wait up to 60 s; open Post-Round; go back to Encounter and reload. (b) On the second chart press Generate Note & Finish again (regenerate) and wait up to 60 s; open Post-Round; reload. Hospital, then Nursing Home

Then (a) The Encounter tab says 'Note not generated' and how to retry; the typed text is still in the box and survives a reload; the Note tab shows no note text and nothing to copy. (b) After the failed regenerate the physician's edited note, including 'QA-EFS-EDIT', is still on the Note tab, also after a reload. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U4a literally: h1/n1 mustContain 'note not generated' (expected to miss on main, Q1; a miss is a plain Fail against TFA-94745 state 4), the typed text, one failure word and one next-step phrase; h2/n2 (Note tab) mustContain the patient's name and mustNotContain note headings and 'Copy to EMR' (U12: no fabricated note); h3/n3 mustContain the typed text after reload; …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
